race.description: The Races Wa Podcast With Britt/Alex/Lochie Hcp (54+)
race.comment: MUST BE NICE (4) improved nicely last start last start at Kalgoorlie, stepping out to 1760m and winning by 1.6L. Up to this trip for the first time, though his late strength last start suggests it won't be an issue. Faithfull sticks and she can go on with the job. DELICATE WARRIOR (3) won by 1L as the equal favourite at Northam last time out. Drops back in trip slightly, though Nottle hops on board now with her 1.5kg claim coming in handy. Well placed to repeat the dose. AWESOME FORCE (6) flew home last start from well back, missing by 2.4L. Out in trip again now is a big tick and he steps out to this trip for the first time. Drawn out, but watch for him late in the race. HOT LIKE CHILI (12) has gone under narrowly her past couple and make her presence felt again. GLOBAL TRIP (8) can improve getting back out in distance.
